title: Old Sober
subject: a yakamein seller pushing two coolers on a grocery cart four miles behind a Sunday second-line parade in New Orleans, selling old sober at every stop
caption: New Orleans second-line brass band music, Sunday street-parade style with funk in the horns. A sousaphone pumping a syncopated bass line; a bass drum with a cymbal on top and a crisp parade snare playing rolling second-line beats; two trumpets trading riffs; trombones with growling smears; a tenor saxophone filling the gaps. Live street-parade sound, loud and roomy, horns bleeding into each other, hand claps. Male lead with a gruff, joyous street-shout delivery and gang call-and-response from the band. 108 BPM, B-flat major. Hot, rowdy and joyful. No drum machine, no synth bass, no electric guitar, no autotune, no hip-hop beat.
lyrics:
[Intro - parade snare roll, sousaphone line and trumpet call]

[Verse 1]
Sunday, one o'clock, the club comes stepping out the door
Green sashes, white shoes, and the tuba starts to roar
I got two coolers on a grocery cart, a ladle and a stack of cups
I walk four miles behind the band till the whole route's eaten up

[Pre-Chorus]
Band stops at the corner bar, I park it on the curb
Lift the lid and let the steam go up, I don't say a word

[Chorus - call and response]
Old sober! (Old sober!)
Beef and noodles, half an egg on top
Hot sauce, soy and a little green onion
Old sober, eight dollars a cup

[Verse 2]
Girl from out of town says, mister, is that ramen in a cup?
I said, sugar, ramen never got a tuba player up
Grand marshal's nephew been out dancing since Friday night
One spoon on the neutral ground and his knees came back to life

[Chorus - call and response]
Old sober! (Old sober!)
Snare drum wants one, trombone wants two
Hot sauce, soy and a little green onion
Old sober, I got one for you

[Bridge - drum break, sousaphone solo, gang vocals]
Where the yakamein man at? (Right behind the band!)
Where the yakamein man at? (Ladle in his hand!)

[Chorus - call and response]
Old sober! (Old sober!)
Sun's going down at the last stop
I scrape the cooler for the trumpet man
Old sober, on the house, last cup

[Outro - full band vamp, crowd claps]
